name: WildBench
description: Benchmark using 1,024 challenging real-world user queries extracted from 1M+ human-chatbot conversations. Uses automated WB-Reward and WB-Score metrics with 0.98 Pearson correlation to Chatbot Arena Elo.
creator: Allen AI

dataset.source: Real user queries from 1M+ chatbot conversations

notes: 0.98 Pearson correlation with Chatbot Arena Elo. Updated monthly. Better than ArenaHard (0.91) and AlpacaEval2 (0.89).
